title: Two Rams Smash Heads at 20 mph. The Crack Echoes Through Mountains

scenes.text: Two rams crash head first at twenty miles an hour.
Biologists say an impact can top two thousand pounds of force.
The crack echoes through the mountains.
Their horns are keratin, like your fingernails, and weigh up to thirty pounds.
Inside, the skull has two layers of bone with a honeycomb cushion between them.
It usually stops serious injury. Head first, twenty miles an hour, again.

description:
Bighorn rams charge at about twenty miles an hour and slam heads in a fight for dominance.
Their double-layered, honeycombed skulls absorb the shock.
Would you survive one hit?
first_comment: Would you rather take one ram hit or one hyena bite?
